thread:
anya: quick closure sync from the postmortem this morning. want a tight list of owners + short test steps so we can close action items ahead of Friday's ops review. Main gaps: route ramping math, restore I/O contention, and runbook decision for partial restores.

kris: i'll own the routing remediation. TSK-10021 created. plan: validate live url-map vs repo, add min-step ramp (5%) and probe delay (20s). ETA: Thu EOD. sample check: `gcloud compute url-maps describe redwood-ingress --region=eu-west1`

omar: i'll take restore concurrency and GC overlap. TSK-10022. test: run 3 parallel restores with retention paused and measure completion p50/p95. ETA: Mon 18:00 UTC.

tess: runbook update is mine. TSK-10023. i'll add an explicit pre-restore quiesce, shard-verify, and a decision flow for partial vs full. will include a 3-step rehearse script. ETA: Wed 10:00 UTC.

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: "Failover validation  routing + restore" Wed 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC. Invitees: anya, kris, omar, tess, eng-sre. Reminder 30m prior.

anya: one more thing: INC-5007 (recurring route spike) needs a short telemetry query. kris/omar please add a dashboard tile for cross-region p95, route-weight delta, and restore errors.

kris: will add a dashboard card and a quick rollback play (reapply previous url-map commit).

omar: will attach sample restore logs + checksum mismatch samples to TSK-10022 and propose retry-with-verify mitigation.

tess: please add a 1-line test step to each ticket by EOD tomorrow so i can run the rehearsal checklist. i'll collate and file the closure note after the run. thanks :)
